value: small, covered by a transparent skin
method: morphological description of preserved type specimens
conditions: Holotype NMMB-P38652 (496 mm TL, Chi-kan, Bai-sha, northern Penghu, 12 July 2021) and three paratypes (NMMB-P38645, 315 mm TL; NMMB-P39317, 462 mm TL; KMNH VR 100650, 297 mm TL), four specimens in all; sexes not reported for any specimen; the sentence is not specific to the holotype

source.title: Species of the snake eel genus Yirrkala Whitley, 1940 from Taiwan, with descriptions of a new species and two new records (Anguilliformes, Ophichthidae)

where: Results, Yirrkala nkust sp. nov., Description
quote: Eye small, covered by a transparent skin; center of eye anterior to mid-jaw …
note: Quote ends before the printed figure reference (Figs 1B, 2B), marked with the ellipsis. Only the first clause (eye small, covered by a transparent skin) is logged; the second clause (eye position) is not. The Description's other eye wording is eye diameter used as a unit of length for snout and jaw measurements; the Diagnosis and Abstract do not mention the eye. The congener Y. kaupii in the same paper has 'Eye moderate in size, covered by a transparent skin; center of eye anterior to mid-jaw (Fig. 4C).' Page prints the CC BY 4.0 licence sentence; Crossref CC BY 4.0 (vor); Crossref author order matches the page; no issue number printed. Species described as new in this paper; no checklist (Catalog of Fishes) opened. Family and order as printed in the title.

method: morphological description of the holotype, a preserved specimen kept alive in captivity until 2012 before fixation
conditions: Description of the holotype only: BMNH 2008.715, mature male, forest soil near Angoulême, French Guiana. The paper lists eight paratypes (BMNH 2008.716-722 and MNHNP 2010.0190): five mature and three immature (BMNH 2008.718-720); the Variation's 'six mature specimens' counts the holotype, and Table 1 gives sex for the mature specimens only. The paratypes' eyes are not described

source.authors: Wilkinson M, Sherratt E, Starace F, Gower DJ
source.title: A New Species of Skin-Feeding Caecilian and the First Report of Reproductive Mode in Microcaecilia (Amphibia: Gymnophiona: Siphonopidae)

where: Materials and Methods, Microcaecilia dermatophaga sp. nov., Description of the holotype
note: Holotype-only statement; the Description does not cover the paratypes, so the value is not logged as species-wide. The Introduction says the genus has small eyes covered with bone and identifies this species 'as a Microcaecilia on the basis of having eyes under bone', so the eyes are present but covered by bone (outside the Description; not logged separately). Diagnosis, Variation and Abstract do not mention the eyes. Sentence does not repeat the species name. Page prints the Creative Commons Attribution License sentence; Crossref CC BY 4.0 with content-version unspecified. Crossref author order matches the page. Species described as new in this paper; no checklist (AmphibiaWeb) opened.
